programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: As the tide rises in New Zealand's Northland Harbours, Stingrays and Eagle rays swim in to feast on shellfish. But they are not the top of the food chain. Only in New Zealand, and only in these harbours do Orca hunt rays. Trapped in the shallows, the rays breach the surface and swim for their lives, as the Orca pursue – with a highly evolved practice for avoiding the rays' stinging tail. As the tide ebbs, the once underwater world of Northland's mangroves surfaces and seethes. Twisted roots that moments ago sheltered fish are now exposed - a seafood platter for patient Herons, Spoonbills, and Shags.

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: Just north of New Zealand's biggest city, tens of thousands of fish school meters from the beach in one of the world's first marine reserves. Inside the Goat Island Reserve giant snapper can live for eighty years and crayfish grow to weigh 8 kilos. Both feed on the thousands of sea urchins that graze the kelp forest, maintaining a delicately balanced ecosystem. Like many of the reserve's inhabitants, they entrust their larvae to the ocean currents - so how do they find their way back to the reef when they take on their adult form and settle down?

programme.title: Our Big Blue Backyard
programme.desc: The East Auckland current warms the waters around the world-renowned Poor Knights Islands, creating an astonishing environment. Caves and arches hold the only known congregation of stingrays which stack themselves between underwater walls. Demoiselles and Black Angelfish fathers protect their eggs with determination, and must keep a watchful eye on neighbors who will raid their nests in an instant! When disaster strikes and the male Sandagers Wrasse disappears, one of the harem of females undergoes a sex change to pick up the missing male's responsibilities. On land, the Tuatara and Giant Weta fuel an ancient feud, while Gannets rest for their next attack.

programme.title: The most spectacular change of seasons
programme.desc: This film explores Central Europe and presents the nature from a perspective you have never seen before. Fascinating landscape footage in high-quality HD technology, coupled with spectacular Cineflex aerial views, take us on a journey through the hitherto unknown blazes of colour of the Central European region and its inhabitants. We show you paradise on earth and demonstrate how climate and astronomy determine our life cycle. While seasons change, we visit several different European habitats that - in their diversity, are exemplary of a Central European region. Mountains, water, forests and meadows: we return to each of these habitats at different times of the year and show how the rhythm of life of each of our protagonists follows nature's clock. The four seasons determine all of the coming and passing away a highly complex interplay in the universe of life. We explore the wondrous worlds of the mysterious cycle of nature together with extraordinary people. Breathtaking landscapes enable us to experience the change of seasons at first hand.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: The Bohemian Forest is the source of the Vltava River, home to primeval forests, untouched high moors and bubbling torrents. This archaic stretch of land, which includes the Bavarian Forest, was long considered impenetrable and mysterious. Since the fall of the Iron Curtain, Bavarian border residents have rediscovered new references to this unusual forest landscape for themselves. This is also the case with photo artist Bastian Kalous, who has been documenting his homeland for years with nostalgic-looking Polaroid photographs and is dealing with its eventful history for an illustrated book. Or Elisa Belotti and Marco Heurich, who have dedicated their lives to the lynxes. In order for Europe's largest wild cat to survive in the Bohemian Forest, the lynx researchers fight for every single animal. Iryna Rudenko came to Zwiesel from Ukraine out of a passion for glass as a material to study at the glass school. After graduation, she would like to stay in Bavaria, Anna Hones grew up in Horská Kvilda, the smallest and highest village in the Czech Republic. The village lies just under 1100 meters above sea level, directly on the former border. The farmer, who experienced communism, the fall of the Iron Curtain and the subsequent changes, is now trying to find ways of surviving in this barren region with her children.

programme.title: Wilderness in Europe: The Bohemian Forest
programme.desc: Pavel Hubeny, whose life would be unthinkable without the forest, is the head of the Šumava National Park. He is committed to ensuring that a primeval forest can grow for future generations, in which man does not interfere. This vision of a primeval forest is also shared by the forester Claus Bässler, who wants to counteract the extinction of species by having trees felled to create artificial deadwood and thus a new habitat for rare beetles and fungi. On the Vltava River lies the small town of Krumlov, the "Pearl of the Bohemian Forest" with its Baroque theater and fully preserved stage technology from the 17th century. Here the director Zuzana Vrbová enchants people from all over the world with her productions. Apart from agriculture, it was mainly the abundance of forests that ensured the livelihood of the inhabitants of the Bohemian Forest - including that of the carpenter Philipp von Manz, who processed local wood for his customers all over Germany. Veterinarian Judith Gollner, who grew up in the Austrian part of the Bohemian Forest, lived in Vienna for a long time and made a conscious decision to return. She likes the people and is proud of "her farmers' wives" who share her love of the Bohemian Forest.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Gates of the Arctic National Park and Preserve is an American national park that protects portions of the Brooks Range in northern Alaska. The park is the northernmost national park in the United States, situated entirely north of the Arctic Circle. The park is the second largest in the US, slightly larger in area than Belgium. Gates of the Arctic was initially designated as a national monument on December 1, 1978, before being redesignated as a national park and preserve upon passage of the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act in 1980. A large part of the park has additional protection as the Gates of the Arctic Wilderness that adjoins the Noatak Wilderness. They form the largest contiguous wilderness in the United States together. Fauna include brown bears, black bears, muskoxen, moose, Dall sheep, timber wolves, wolverines, coyotes, lynxes, marmots, porcupines, river otters, red and Arctic fox species, beavers, snowshoe hares, muskrats, bald eagles, golden eagles, peregrine falcons, ospreys, great horned and northern hawk-owls. More than half a million caribou, including the Central Arctic, Western Arctic, Teshekpuk, and Porcupine herds, migrate through the central Brooks Range twice yearly, traveling north in summer, and south in winter. Caribou are important as a food source to native peoples. The park is the northernmost range limit for the Dall sheep. About 132 brown bears reside in the park and preserve, based on a density of about one bear per 100 square miles.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: The Grand Canyon is a steep-sided canyon carved by the Colorado River in Arizona, United States. The Grand Canyon is 277 miles (446 km) long, up to 18 miles (29 km) wide and attains a depth of over a mile (6,093 feet or 1,857 meters). The canyon and adjacent rim are contained within Grand Canyon National Park, the Kaibab National Forest, Grand Canyon–Parashant National Monument, the Hualapai Indian Reservation, the Havasupai Indian Reservation and the Navajo Nation. President Theodore Roosevelt was a major proponent of preservation of the Grand Canyon area and visited it on numerous occasions to hunt and enjoy the scenery.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Saguaro National Park is an American national park in Pima County, southeastern Arizona. The 92,000-acre (37,000 ha) park consists of two separate areas—the Tucson Mountain District (TMD) about 10 miles west of the city of Tucson and the Rincon Mountain District (RMD) about 10 miles east of the city—that preserve Sonoran Desert landscapes, fauna, and flora, including the giant saguaro cactus.An inventory of medium and large mammals in the park confirmed the presence of 30 species in Saguaro National Park between 1999 and 2008. Of these, 21 were found in the Tucson Mountain District and 29 in the Rincon Mountain District. A partial list of the park's mammals includes cougars, coyotes, bobcats, white-tailed deer, mule deer, javelinas, gray foxes, black-tailed jackrabbits, desert cottontails, ring-tailed cats, white-nosed coatis, ground squirrels, and packrats. One endangered mammal, the lesser long-nosed bat, lives part of the year in the park and part of the year in Mexico.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: mareTV: Curacao, Blue Wonder of the Caribbean
programme.desc: Curacao is one of the most popular attractions for countless cruise ships on their trips through the Caribbean, because it is located outside of the hurricane belt. This is why Eric Miguel is constantly in action. He is the bridge keeper of the Queen Emma Bridge, the landmark of Curacao's capital, Willemstad. After his shift, Eric goes to Yvonne Troeman's cook-shop. Her speciality is Kadushi, a cactus soup. The ingredients include cactus flesh, pigtail's, mussels and a few secret "treats". Barbara van Bebber is the only submarine pilot on Curacao and literally gets to the bottom of things amidst the turquoise-blue wonder of the Caribbean. She charters out her sub to marine biologists and wealthy private explorers, simultaneously cleaning up on the seabed. Her "Curasub" has claw arms, which she employs to remove anything that doesn't belong down there: beer bottles, car tyres, and plastic refuse. Jeroen Eikelenboom simply carts sand from a neighbouring cove to his own surf club in his favourite bay.

programme.title: Forests
programme.desc: Shrouded in myth and legend, the forests of Germany are world famous, thanks to the fairy tales of the Brothers Grimm. The strange creatures that actually live there are shown in the episode Forests of the four-part series Wild Germany. A lynx out hunting, red deer stags roar to call their harems together, wild boar forage in dead leaves looking for nuts. When one considers how densely populated it is, Germany is home to a surprising number of different species. Around one third of the country is covered in forest. Forests enters a world full of magic and shows the secretive inhabitants you won't see when out for a walk. Spring in the Black Forest brings out the cherry blossom. Not long now, and the fruit used to make the famous Black Forest Gâteau will appear. A doe has deposited its fawn in the high grass under the trees. Nearby, a vixen is on the look-out for food for her cubs. She would just about be able to handle the fawn ... Life in the forest is full of drama. Humans are rarely seen, the animal adventures take place behind a thick curtain of leaves. The wildcat and the lynx have managed to reconquer some regions from which they had long disappeared. For rare animals like black stork and stag beetle, the woods offer a last refuge. The best nature film-makers in Germany spent more than five years travelling the country from the Harz mountains to the Bavarian Forest, from Saxonian Switzerland to the Palatinate Forest, collecting material on the secret lives of forest dwellers.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are back, after a short break it feels like we never even left. We're here in Vaasa - Finland kicking off 2022 new world series. If you are watching at home, just like these people, you're in the right place. Because this is a special edition world record breaker. The only question left today, is to see how many new world records will be set so stay tuned.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are here in Doetinchem – Holland, for Stage 2 and 3 in the hottest day of the year. 40-degree heat, these boys have to work harder than they ever have. The sun is going to be beating down, they're going to be sweating, hydration is going to be key today. I also reckon they're all going to be wearing their sunglasses. Let's see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: So there you have it. The next day, 3 more events in 40 Degrees heat. We've got Gavin coming into day 2 leading the pack. Kelvin De Ruiter our world champion struggling a little bit at the moment, but Yoke Race, Conan's Wheel and then Stones to finish. There is a lot to be played for here, so stay tuned to see if Gavin can take the lead and beat Kelvin overall.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We're in the Serbian city of Novi kozarci, for the next stage in the world series. And what a fantastic line up we have for you again. But it is going to be one of the hottest stages yet. A Strongman competition in 44-degree heat. It will be a real challenge for these athletes to finish this event. From all over the world the strongmen came here for the title! Welcome to the heat hell in Serbia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to day 2 in Serbia, and its another baking hot one. We are in Kikinda today! We've got three more gruelling events for our athletes. Sami Ahola is leading the pack, so can he be the first Finnish athlete to take an SCL title. Stay tuned to find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this competition, we have our athletes paired up. They're going to have to take on each event together, having to factor in each other's strengths and possibly weaknesses. Can the men who normally work alone, share their powers as a duo? Let's find out!

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Day 2 of the famous Team World championship here in Finland- Joensuu. Welcome to the final day of the world's strongest team event. The race to be the best team in the world is coming to its crowing point. All is still wide open for any of these to take the title. Who is going to win? Will team Latvia keep their World Title or maybe Finland can attach them? Keep watching and we'll find out.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome back to Strongman Champions League for another stage of the 2022 world tour. We're in Esposende - Portugal in this beautiful setting next to the beach in front of a packed crowd with some of the strongest men the world has to offer. With a real Porsche deadlift and many other crazy stuff. So, lets get this show started.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: Awakening
programme.desc: When Mateo's comic creation, Z-Blob, follows him from a dream back to Brooklyn, Mateo and his sister realize the Dream World is real, and in danger!

programme.title: Dream Chasers
programme.desc: After a daring mission to save their friend in the Dream World, Mateo and Izzie find the nightmare has followed them back to the Waking World.

programme.title: Legacy, Vehicle and Mechs
programme.desc: Zane takes help from Nya for backup memories of their adventures to the Samurai X Cave computer, but Zane encounters a mysterious puzzle buried deep within his code. Nya digitizes Jay and uploads him into Zane's mind. Jay reviews memories of the Ninja's various motorcycles, mechs and planes in order to solve the vehicle-themed puzzle.

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.

programme.title: Spooky Sensation
programme.desc: The girls decided to spend a weekend at the hotel. It appears to be haunted. Watch the full video to know more about this.

programme.title: Sings of Love
programme.desc: See how Stephanie and Olivia enter the Under the Sea photo competition. Jacob wrote a love song! Olivia and her friends are very excited to hear. Tanya and Stephanie are teamed up in baking class. Watch the video for more fun.

programme.title: Video Wonder
programme.desc: Olivia and Andrea visited science camp with Mrs Stevens. On the other hand, Andrea and Mia decides to return a lost skunk to nature. Andrea was reading intimate postcards between Chef Pierre and Mrs. Stevens.

programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword. Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard. The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.4
programme.desc: A new personality appears in Do Hyun — this time, that of a young child — leaving him shocked. Meanwhile, Se Gi drags Ri Jin off to somewhere unknown.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.5
programme.desc: Se Gi, who has kidnapped Ri Jin, asks her to make Do Hyun disappear forever. Director Ahn begins tracking their whereabouts. Meanwhile, Do Hyun ends up at Ri On's house, and Ri On introduces him to his family as “Mr. Perry.”

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.6
programme.desc: Do Hyun can't stop thinking about Ri Jin, which only fuels Se Gi's jealousy. Eventually, Se Gi warns him, “If you touch my woman, yours will be in danger.” Provoked, Do Hyun goes to Ri Jin and asks her to become his secret personal doctor.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.7
programme.desc: Tae Im questions Director Ahn about the reason for Do Hyun's return to Korea, leaving him flustered. Ri Jin struggles to stop Yo Seob from taking his own life. Hwa Ran orders someone to find Min Seo Yeon's long-lost child, while Do Hyun begins strategizing to meet the mysterious writer Omega.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.8
programme.desc: Gi Joon proposes to Chae Yeon, but she gets angry at his attitude. Ri Jin agrees to be Do Hyun's secret doctor, but is shocked to learn she has to live in the same house as him. Thus begins their uneasy and awkward cohabitation.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.9
programme.desc: Ri Jin encounters all of Do Hyun's personalities in one night — except for Shin Se Gi. Gi Joon and Chae Yeon are stunned when Ri Jin shows up at the company as Do Hyun's secretary, while Ri On meets Do Hyun under his secret identity as Writer Omega.

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.314
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's episode of I'm LIVE is singer-songwriter MOVNING! MOVNING is known for his trademark, consoling piano sounds that match beautifully with his calm vocals. He debuted in 2016 with the single “Life is a Rainbow” and then made himself known to the public in 2018 through the song “Everything I Love Will Make Me Cry.” The 2018 release also earned him the nicknames of “an artist that every listener should listen to” and “an artist that deserves to top all the music charts.” In June this year, MOVNING made its much-anticipated comeback with the song “Your Name, Youth.” With magnificent string sounds, this new release beautifully portrays “youth,” an age of uncertainty and turmoil, yet possibly the most precious thing in life. Tune in to I'm LIVE and feel the ultimate beauty of youth once again with MOVNING!In this episode, MOVNING performs “Life is a Rainbow,” “Everything I Love Will Make Me Cry,” “Twilight of Youth,” “Your Name, Youth,” and more to nourish our souls.

programme.title: I'm LIVE Ep.315
programme.desc: Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet TOUCHED!Joining us on this week's episode of I'm LIVE is a band ready to touch our heart - TOUCHED! TOUCHED is back on I'm LIVE 2 years after their first appearance and performs “Hi Bully,” “Alive,” “Shut Down,” “Love is Dangerous,” and more to show off their flawless musicality. TOUCHED is comprised of vocalist and guitarist Yunmin, drummer Kim Seung-bin, bassist John B. Kim, guitarist D.on, and keyboardist Chae Do-hyeon. With their intense sounds and wide spectrum of music, the quintet has been praised for opening a new era in the band music scene. They are also the first band to have won the Grand Prize at the Yoo Jae-ha Music Contest and have taken home top prizes from many other music contests, mesmerizing both critics and general listeners.

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: INDIPEDIA
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: LOST RECIPES
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.desc: In questa commovente favola natalizia, il vero Babbo Natale (Leslie Nielsen) cade dalla slitta e inizia a soffrire di amnesia. Presto si imbatte in un annoiato reporter televisivo che rappresenta la sua unica speranza di riacquistare la memoria e salvare le feste.

programme.title: Sorbole… che romagnola
programme.desc: Cult della commedia all'italiana . Una avvenente guida turistica romagnola, per l'errore di un'agenzia, è costretta a pagare un conto salatissimo nell'albergo dove alloggia. Essendo al verde, si reinventa dietologa, aiutando le mogli trascurate degli abitanti del luogo a tornare in forma.

programme.title: La scelta di restare
programme.desc: Damanhur è una comunità spirituale situata in Valchiusella, Piemonte, che si considera una micronazione non riconosciuta dallo Stato italiano. Fondata negli anni '70, la comunità ha costruito segretamente un tempio sotterraneo, il più grande al mondo, riconosciuto dal Guinness dei Primati.

programme.title: Le tardone
programme.desc: Stupendo film con celebri attori, tra cui Franco Franchi, Ciccio Ingrassia, Walter Chiari e Raimondo Vianello. Cinque donne non più giovanissime sono le protagoniste di cinque episodi nel più classico stile della commedia all'italiana: dalla svitata di turno, alla ballerina di flamenco, per concludere con la classica adultera. Cinque divertenti ritratti di donne irresistibili.

programme.title: La settimana al mare
programme.desc: Un divertentissimo cult della commedia italiana anni '80 con Bombolo, Enzo Cannavale, Annamaria Rizzoli e Vincenzo Crocitti. Carlo, studente universitario, è figlio unico e sua madre Elvira, per proteggerlo, lo ha reso timido e indifeso. Il padre Antonio decide allora d'intervenire e, all'insaputa della moglie, porta il figlio in vacanza con sé in un villaggio turistico.

programme.title: Amanti
programme.desc: Una donna americana gravemente malata incontra in Italia un affascinante ingegnere. I due vivono un amore intenso e segreto, trasformando pochi giorni insieme in una parentesi assoluta contro il tempo.

programme.title: Una Moglie Americana
programme.desc: Un italiano sposato e insoddisfatto arriva a New York e sogna di rifarsi una vita sposando una ricca americana. La caccia alla moglie perfetta si trasforma in una satira di ambizioni, opportunismo e illusioni.

programme.title: Le ore dell'amore
programme.desc: Dopo tre anni di amore, Gianni e Maretta decidono di sposarsi. La routine coniugale spegne però la passione e li spinge verso goffi tentativi di evasione, finché capiscono di dover reinventare il loro rapporto.

programme.title: Guardia, ladro e cameriera
programme.desc: Durante un furto, una cameriera viene coinvolta in un equivoco che mette insieme un ladro improvvisato e una guardia notturna. Tra sospetti, inseguimenti e sentimenti inattesi, la notte si trasforma in una commedia degli errori.

programme.title: Miseria e nobiltà
programme.desc: Due famiglie poverissime vengono ingaggiate da un giovane marchese per fingersi aristocratiche e favorire il suo matrimonio con la figlia di un ricco cuoco. La messinscena degenera in una travolgente farsa.

programme.title: La grande abbuffata
programme.desc: In una villa fuori Parigi quattro vecchi amici si riuniscono per un week-end abbandonandosi ad un`orgia di cibo e sesso. Uno di loro, Marcello, porta con sé alcune prostitute che disgustate dall`ambiente se ne andranno. Ad un certo punto una maestra va lì per caso con in suoi alunni in visita al giardino della villa, rimane affascinata dai quattro e decide di fare ritorno unendosi a loro nel folle e autodistruttivo fine settimana...

programme.title: Ciao maschio
programme.desc: Il rifiuto della paternità e la scelta di adottare come figlio una scimmietta saranno per il protagonista, Lafayette , l'ultima e delirante affermazione di individualità.

programme.title: Vita da cani
programme.desc: Tre ragazze condividono un sogno: fare fortuna. Franca è occupata in una fabbrica ed stanca di fare la vita dell`operaia: abbandona quindi il fidanzato, un giovane meccanico, per recarsi a Roma, dove spera di trovare un ricco amante.Vera è una ballerina in una compagnia di guitti del varietà che abbandona i suoi sogni per amore. Margherita, invece, è una timida ragazzina che sogna di intraprendere la carriera di attrice...

programme.title: Piccolo mondo antico
programme.desc: Durante il Risorgimento, un giovane di nobile casato sposa, contro il volere della nonna austricante, una donna borghese e va a vivere sul lago di Como. La loro bambina annega per una svista fatale, e la giovane madre quasi impazzisce. Si riprende solo quando lo sposo, che intanto ha aderito ai movimenti clandestini rivoluzionari, annuncia la sua partenza per la guerra di Crimea.

programme.title: Monster on the Campus
programme.desc: Uno scienziato, entrando in contatto col plasma di un celacanto (pesce primordiale realmente esistente), subisce un'involuzione che lo trasforma in un primate dagli istinti omicidi.

programme.title: Un mondo d'amore
programme.desc: Inverno del 1949. L'insegnante Pier Paolo Pasolini viene incriminato dai carabinieri per corruzione di minorenne ed atti osceni. Durante un festa di paese a Ramuscello, nella campagna friulana, aveva convinto alcuni ragazzini ad appartarsi con lui. I militari dell'Arma procedettero in base ad alcune voci. A crollare fu il mondo di Pier Paolo, a cominiciare dal padre, Carlo Alberto, che piombò in una depressione distruttiva. Il poeta non resterà altro che partire insieme alla madre per Roma.

programme.title: Luci d'inverno
programme.desc: Il pastore Tomas, in crisi di fede dopo la morte della moglie, non riesce a dare conforto a un uomo disperato, che si toglie la vita. Travolto dal senso di colpa, trova un nuovo equilibrio grazie a Maria, una maestra che lo aiuta a riscoprire la speranza.

programme.title: Ithaca
programme.desc: Primavera del 1942. Dopo la partenza del fratello per il fronte, Homer Macauley, 14 anni, è determinato a diventare il più veloce portalettere dell'ufficio del telegrafo così da poter mantenere la sua numerosa famiglia. E così, mentre sull'isola di Ithaca la primavera lascia il posto all'estate, il giovane Homer passa le sue giornata a recapitare messaggi d'amore e di speranza ma anche di dolore e morte, finché anche lui non riceverà un messaggio che gli cambierà la vita per sempre

programme.title: L'imperdibile viaggio di Harold Fry
programme.desc: Harold è un uomo qualunque che ha sempre vissuto senza prendere iniziative. Un giorno scopre che una vecchia amica è molto malata e decide di andarla a trovare attraversando a piedi l'Inghilterra.

programme.title: Scambio di identità
programme.desc: Connie, nubile ed incinta, viaggia in direzione di Boston in treno ed incontra una giovane e facoltosa coppia di sposini in luna di miele, Hugh e Patricia. Durante il tragitto, il convoglio subisce un incidente grave e la ragazza finisce in ospedale.

programme.title: Half Nelson
programme.desc: Candidatura agli Oscar per Ryan Gosling. Dan è un insegnante di scuola pubblica, brillante e capace di motivare i suoi allievi nonostante le difficoltà della vita di periferia. Nel privato però affoga i suoi tormenti nell'abuso di alcool e droghe.

programme.title: Ballando a Lughnasa
programme.desc: Alla vigilia della guerra di Spagna, in un paese irlandese vive una famiglia composta da sole donne. Il ritorno a casa del fratello missionario in Africa fa emergere tensioni sentimentali troppo a lungo sopite.

programme.title: Tutta colpa di Sara
programme.desc: Dopo essere stata notificata della richiesta di divorzio, una donna convince un ufficiale giudiziario ad aiutarla a riottenere ciò che le è dovuto.

programme.title: Le Ragazze Di Campagna
programme.desc: Tre giovani donne provenienti da percorsi di vita molto diversi si uniscono all'esercito di terra femminile durante la Seconda Guerra Mondiale e vengono inviate a lavorare insieme in una fattoria nel Dorset. L'esperienza cambierà per sempre le loro vite.

programme.title: Hesher è stato qui
programme.desc: T.J. è un ragazzino a cui è morta da due mesi la madre in un incidente stradale. La vita familiare è stata sconvolta dal decesso: il padre Paul vegeta in depressione in casa e la nonna cerca in qualche modo di accudire i due sopravvissuti.

programme.title: Premonitions
programme.desc: L'agente speciale dell'FBI Joe Merriwether non riesce a fare luce su una misteriosa catena di delitti. Ingaggia così un suo ex collaboratore in pensione, il medico psicanalista John Clancy, allo scopo di risolvere il caso.

programme.title: American Skin
programme.desc: Il colore della pelle, in America, conta. Conta eccome. Se sei nero. Lincoln Jefferson è un veterano del corpo dei Marines e lavora come custode in un prestigioso liceo della California: un lavoro che si è trovato per garantire l'iscrizione alla scuola del figlio quattordicenne, KJ.

programme.title: Abduction
programme.desc: Nathan frequenta il liceo, è innamorato della vicina di casa, è campione di wrestling per volere del padre, che lo sottopone ad un continuo allenamento e lo vorrebbe lontano dalle sbronze e sempre vigile.

programme.title: La città verrà distrutta all'alba
programme.desc: Immaginate di vivere in una piccola città dove tutto è sicuro e felice... finché improvvisamente non lo è più. In un terrificante racconto del "Sogno Americano" andato terribilmente storto, quattro abitanti di Ogden Marsh, IA, si ritrovano intrappolati nella loro città natale.

programme.title: Un Ragionevole Dubbio
programme.desc: Mitch, un brillante procuratore, investe accidentalmente un passante, scappando senza prestargli soccorso. Dopo aver scoperto che un uomo è stato arrestato al suo posto, i sensi di colpa spingeranno Mitch a far cadere le accuse. E se Mitch si fosse sbagliato? Se quell'uomo non fosse innocente?

programme.title: Awake Anestesia cosciente
programme.desc: Sebbene il suo corpo sia completamente paralizzato dall'anestesia, Clay rimane consapevole per tutta la durata dell'intervento, sperimentando così la 'consapevolezza intraoperatoria'. Questa esperienza, tra il delirio e la realtà, avrà ripercussioni nella sua vita perché emergeranno segreti nascosti.

programme.title: Traitor
programme.desc: Quando l'agente dell'FBI Roy Clayton dirige le indagini riguardanti una pericolosa cospirazione internazionale, tutti gli indizi sembrano ricondurre all'ex ufficiale delle operazioni speciali americane Samir Horn.

programme.title: Grace is Gone
programme.desc: Un padre vedovo porta le figlie in viaggio prima di dir loro la verità

programme.title: Il mio San Valentino
programme.desc: Dopo che il suo fidanzato l'ha lasciata il giorno di San Valentino, Piper, organizzatrice di proposte di matrimonio, ha perso la fiducia nelle relazioni amorose. Lavorando ad un nuovo ingaggio, la donna conosce Adam, il fratello del promesso sposo.

programme.title: Innamorarsi a Valentine
programme.desc: Quando Kennedy riceve in eredità un ranch nella cittadina di Valentine, prende subito accordi per venderlo. In poco tempo però la ragazza si affeziona al ranch e rimane affascinata dal suo manager, Derek Sterling. Kennedy decide allora di trascorrere l'estate in campagna e di ristabilire i contatti con il resto della famiglia, ma le cose non vanno come previsto...

programme.title: Hot Corn Cine News
programme.desc: Live dall' 83ª Mostra del cinema di Venezia! Uno sguardo ravvicinato ad alcuni dei migliori film italiani passati dal festival: L'estranea di Paolo Strippoli Il fuoco che ti porti dentro, con un'intervista a Edoardo De Angelis La città dei vivi, con un'intervista al protagonista, Emanuele Maria Di Stefano Scherzetto, con interviste a Mario Martone, Serena Rossi e Toni Servillo Nessun dolore, con interviste a Gianni Amelio e Alessandro Borghi.

programme.title: Gli ingredienti dell'amore
programme.desc: Zoey noleggia un food truck per partecipare a un reality show. Tra lei e il fondatore di un ristorante, che è anche giudice del concorso, volano scintille. Zoey vuole vincere, ma sospetta che lui stia cercando la sua ricetta della salsa, non il suo cuore.

programme.title: Vuoi cucinare con me?
programme.desc: Joel è l'arrogante proprietario di una famosa catena di fast food a base di piatti messicani. Alla ricerca di nuovi piatti da proporre con successo nel menu, parte per il New Mexico, dove la grintosa Javiera Torres è famosa per le sue prelibatezze culinarie.

programme.title: Cucinare con amore
programme.desc: La laboriosa produttrice televisiva, Kelly, non ha tempo per l'amore. Kelly si tuffa in un'altra stagione di un programma di cucina per bambini, quando lo chef Stephen dalla testa calda viene catapultato nella vita di Kelly come ospite sostituto dell'ultimo minuto. Mentre i due lottano per realizzare uno spettacolo di successo, si rendono conto di avere molto più in comune di quanto pensassero.

programme.title: Stop The Wedding
programme.desc: Un uomo e una donna impiccioni, determinati a fermare un matrimonio per il bene della sposa e dello sposo, finiscono per innamorarsi l'uno dell'altra.

programme.title: Un matrimonio da salvare
programme.desc: Jess e Max sono pronti ad annullare il loro matrimonio per lo stress eccessivo causato dal l'organizzazione fuori controllo dell'evento e da tutto quello che ne è conseguito. Ormai alla frutta, si recano da Billie, una dolce 'sempre damigella d'onore' che ha un'associazione no-profit che si occupa di donare alle persone meno abbienti e con bisogni speciali, allestimenti di feste di matrimonio già pagati e mai avvenuti. Tuttavia, Charlie, il fratello di Max, non si fermerà davanti a nulla pur di tenere insieme Jess e Max e per fare ciò, chiede aiuto a Billie, allettandola con un aiuto extra per la sua attività.

programme.title: La baia dell'amore
programme.desc: Una biologa marina intelligente e seria e un istruttore di immersioni divertente e laissez‑faire devono collaborare per salvare la loro amata barriera corallina prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.title: Brace for Impact: indagine ad alta quota
programme.desc: Una detective dell'FBI perde il fratello in un incidente aereo e decidere di indagare sull'accaduto per conto proprio, rompendo le regole del servizio di intelligence e scoprendo un complotto terroristico.

programme.title: Burden of Evil
programme.desc: Quando la figlia di un potente senatore viene rapita da uno psicopatico, l'uomo pretende che ad occuparsi delle indagini sia la detective della squadra omicidi Caitlyn Conner.

programme.title: Un bambino per due
programme.desc: L'ambiziosa Layla Bennet conduce il programma mattutino Wake Up Chicago! con il suo affascinante collega Derek Dray. Non vanno sempre d'accordo e quando improvvisamente devono prendersi cura di un bambino insieme, il loro incubo peggiore diventa realtà!

programme.title: Love on Trend
programme.desc: Quando una blogger di moda riceve un nuovo numero di cellulare, riceve messaggi e inviti destinati alla donna affascinante che possedeva il numero prima di lei. Si immerge così in questa vita più eccitante, innamorandosi persino dell'affascinante ex fidanzato della donna.

programme.title: Due perfetti rivali
programme.desc: In un sobborgo di Chicago, le due pizzerie Romanos e Juliatos si contendono da anni la clientela in città.

programme.title: L'amore sa dove trovarti
programme.desc: Emma, giovane Amish con il cuore pieno dei romanzi di Jane Austen, sogna una vita oltre i confini della sua comunità. Durante un'estate in Ohio, si ritrova sospesa tra due mondi e due amori: Noah, fedele alle radici, e Andy, un giornalista che le offre la libertà.

programme.title: Le ragazze di Piazza di Spagna
programme.desc: Tre ragazze di estrazione popolare lavorano come sarte presso un'importante casa di moda romana. Il loro obiettivo è quello di sposarsi e il lavoro è solo un mezzo per ottenere la dote nel modo più veloce possibile.

programme.title: Till
programme.desc: "Till - la giustizia di una madre" è un film molto toccante sulla vera storia dell'incessante ricerca della giustizia da parte di Mamie Till-Mobley, il cui figlio di 14 anni, Emmett Till, in visita ai cugini in Mississippi, fu linciato nel 1955.

programme.title: Il ritorno
programme.desc: Teresa vive con Pietro e il piccolo Antonio, il figlio di due anni. Purtroppo la situazione economica, sociale e la poca affidabilità di Pietro costringono Teresa a compiere un gesto estremo per il quale finisce in carcere per dieci anni.

programme.title: Tutto su mia madre
programme.desc: Esteban è alla ricerca della sua parte mancante, il padre. Ma sarà la madre ad intraprendere il viaggio che la porterà a delle scoperte sconvolgenti.

programme.title: Sunchaser
programme.desc: Blue è un giovane navajo che sta scontando una duplice condanna ed è affetto da un tumore incurabile che non gli lascia scampo. Convinto che la sua unica speranza sia raggiungere un luogo mistico sulle montagne sacre, prende in ostaggio il medico curante...

programme.title: Amore alla moda
programme.desc: Quando una fashionista cambia il suo numero di telefono, riceve messaggi dall'ex della donna che in precedenza possedeva quel numero. Il suo nuovo numero è stato l'inizio di una storia d'amore?

programme.title: Ti va di ballare?
programme.desc: La vita di un vedovo prende una svolta inaspettata quando si mette in viaggio per cercare l'amore perduto di un uomo che sta morendo.

programme.title: Amore tra le vigne
programme.desc: Quando la scrittrice della rivista di Seattle Samantha Hart viene mandata a casa per scrivere un articolo sul matrimonio destinazione Hawthorne Vineyards, scopre che l'ex che le ha spezzato il cuore non solo gestisce il vigneto, ma sta per sposarsi lì.

programme.title: Amarsi sotto la pioggia
programme.desc: Casey decide di rispettare le ultime volontà di sua madre e si reca a Londra per consegnare una lettera a Lord Benton. La donna si innamora del figlio del nobile britannico, Micheal.

programme.title: Dopo l'amore
programme.desc: Marie e Boris, dopo quindici anni di matrimonio, vivono separati in casa a causa di difficoltà economiche e per il bene delle figlie. Questo dramma contemporaneo esplora i paradossi e le sfide di una relazione che si sgretola lentamente.

programme.title: La storia dell'amore
programme.desc: C'era una volta un ragazzo, Léo, che amava una ragazza, Alma. Le aveva promesso che l'avrebbe fatta ridere per tutta la vita, ma la guerra li ha separati. Da un paesino della Polonia negli anni Trenta alla New York dei giorni nostri ripercorriamo la straordinaria storia d'amore tra Léo, l'uomo che è sopravvissuto a tutto e Alma, la donna più amata del mondo. Oggi un'altra Alma, adolescente newyorchese e contagiata dallo stesso virus meraviglioso dell'amore, vuole essere la donna più amata del mondo. Sembra che niente leghi Léo alla giovane Alma ma… L'amore attraverserà il tempo e i continenti per unire i loro destini.

programme.title: Non ti posso dimenticare
programme.desc: Fred Astaire impersona un eroico pilota della seconda guerra mondiale innamorato di una dattilografa la quale, ignara del suo valore, lo disprezza credendolo un imboscato. Alla fine la donna scoprirà la verità.

programme.title: The Gods
programme.desc: In un moderno Romeo e Giulietta, Mikey James, un imbroglione cresciuto per strada con i suoi due fratelli, va a lavorare per la famiglia Fasano mentre cerca disperatamente di trovare una via d'uscita dal suo stile di vita frenetico.

programme.title: Mrs. Mills
programme.desc: Helene possiede un appartamento chic nel centro di Parigi, pubblica romanzi romanticamente kitsch e conduce una vita completamente dettata dal lavoro. Tutto il suo amore è per i libri. Ma la sua vita quotidiana viene stravolta quando la signora Mills, un'eccentrica signora americana, si trasferisce nell'appartamento accanto.

programme.title: Un neomelodico presidente
programme.desc: Il cantante neomelodico Leopoldo Giappone, in arte Mimmo Dany, si candida a presidente della regione Campania con una lista a sé, l'UVC. Il suo sogno tuttavia resta quello di partecipare al reality show L'isola dei famosi, e per questo ha a che fare con la malavita.

programme.title: Maledimiele
programme.desc: Maledimiele è la storia di Sara, un'adolescente di quindici anni che si ammala di anoressia. Inizialmente nessuno sembra accorgersi di niente: sia i genitori che le amiche del cuore faticano a vedere l'evolversi della malattia…

programme.title: Dopo l'amore
programme.desc: Marie e Boris, dopo quindici anni di matrimonio, vivono separati in casa a causa di difficoltà economiche e per il bene delle figlie. Questo dramma contemporaneo esplora i paradossi e le sfide di una relazione che si sgretola lentamente.

programme.title: Una ragazza sfrenata
programme.desc: Un'ereditiera insoddisfatta è il bersaglio di un insospettabile ladro d'auto che viene trascinata inavvertitamente in un complotto per sequestrarla

programme.title: L'uomo Di Casa
programme.desc: L'inflessibile ranger Roland Sharp (Tommy Lee Jones) rintraccia un informante chiave con l'aiuto di un ex delinquente (Cedric the Entertainer).

programme.title: Here Comes The Boom
programme.desc: Il professore di biologia Scott Voss conduce una vita ed un lavoro noioso, finché un suo collega Streb gli confida che aspetta un figlio. Ad una riunione dove il preside decide di diminuire il lavoro, decide anche di eliminare il corso di musica tenuto dal suo collega. Voss si propone di salvare il corso del collega cercando di recuperare 48.000 dollari. Dopo varie idee, a Voss viene l'idea di partecipare ad incontri di MMA, e nonostante le prime sconfitte, anche grazie ai suoi studenti riuscirà a vincere la sfida.

programme.title: Tutte le ex del mio ragazzo
programme.desc: Brittany Murphy catturerà il vostro cuore in questo divertentissimo film su una brava ragazza che non ne combina una giusta. Assunta per lavorare in un talk show televisivo, la vita di Stacy Holt è stravolta quando viene convinta ad esplorare uno dei temi del programma e controlla l'agenda del suo ragazzo. Ma si è dimenticata una cosa: nel mondo della TV, c'è sempre una sorpresa scioccante dietro l'angolo -- e lei ne avrà una bella grande!

programme.title: I due crociati
programme.desc: Ciccio e Franco, disastri tra Crociati e Saraceni, rovesciano per caso le sorti dello scontro finale.

programme.title: Travolto dagli affetti familiari
programme.desc: Un uomo cerca di bilanciare un matrimonio d'interesse con l'affetto per nonna e cane

programme.title: Furto di sera bel colpo si spera
programme.desc: Quinto, ladro sfortunato, passa dalle auto ai salumi e ai quadri, finendo sempre in ospedale o in galera

programme.title: Il magnate
programme.desc: Clara, moglie di Furio Cicerone, rifiuta il conte Arienti, ma intrighi finanziari mettono tutto a rischio

programme.title: Fifa e arena
programme.desc: Commedia di Mario Mattoli con Totò e Isa Barzizza: per un equivoco Nicolino è scambiato per un criminale e fugge a Siviglia. Tra gag, travestimenti e corrida, combinano guai esilaranti in una Spagna tutta napoletana.

programme.title: Il marito
programme.desc: Alberto Sordi interpreta un uomo che, coinvolto in una serie di equivoci e malintesi, si trova a dover affrontare le difficoltà della sua vita matrimoniale. Una commedia che esplora con ironia le dinamiche delle relazioni e del matrimonio.

programme.title: Il medico dei pazzi
programme.desc: Dalla commedia di Eduardo Scarpetta. Totò è il generoso zio di uno scapestrato nipote, che l'ha ingannato dicendo di essersi laureato e di dirigere una clinica psichiatrica (in realtà la clinica non esiste, è solo un mezzo per spillar quattrini). Totò un giorno arriva a Napoli per controllare la vita del nipotastro. Capita nella pensione di questi e prende i pensionanti per matti.

programme.title: Accadde al penitenziario
programme.desc: In un penitenziario, le disavventure di un gruppo di detenuti e delle loro relazioni con il personale, tra situazioni comiche e paradossali, creando un mix di risate e riflessioni sulla vita dietro le sbarre.

programme.title: Quel fantasma di mio marito
programme.desc: Un uomo, ucciso in un incidente, ritorna come un "fantasma" per aiutare la sua moglie a superare il dolore della sua morte e a trovare la felicità. Una commedia che gioca su spirito e sentimenti in modo divertente e malinconico.

programme.title: Comic Movie
programme.desc: Per vendicarsi di un pesce d'aprile ricevuto da un ragazzino esperto d'informatica, due adolescenti decidono di rimpinzargli il computer di virus.

programme.title: How to Be a Latin Lover
programme.desc: Eugenio Derbez (INSTRUCTIONS NOT INCLUDED) capitana un cast stellare in questa commedia divertente e spassosissima.

programme.title: Rebelles

During the first investigations, the police find an odd manuscript from a tomb.

Runa, the oldest daughter, takes over her fathers chores in his absence. She is becoming aware of something vile out in the forest. One day she finds a bleeding man. She brings him inside, as he heals, she realizes he is sent to protect the family.

Un certo numero di indizi portano ad un gruppo di studenti di un collegio vicino ma il caso è chiuso quando un uomo si dichiara colpevole e viene condannato. Quando, 20 anni dopo, il caso finisce sulla scrivania di Carl Mørck, il detective si rende subito conto che c'è qualcosa di terribilmente sbagliato. Insieme ad Assad, collega e amico, Carl inizia ad indagare sul caso e, trovando una vecchia chiamata d'emergenza di una ragazza disperata, si rende conto che questa sembri sapere cosa sia accaduto. Così i due si mettono sulle tracce di Kimmie, che è scomparsa dal tempo degli omicidi. Ma Carl e Assad non sono gli unici che cercano di rintracciarla come testimone. In realtà la ragazza è in grande pericolo perché un gruppo di uomini influenti farà tutto il possibile per mantenere il suo silenzio….
